description: Hi! I'm Retaj, a Network and Cybersecurity student interested in AI, web development, and innovation. I worked on SEVAS, an emergency alert system that won 1st place at ITC Egypt 2026. I'm looking for creative teammates skilled in AI, Python, data analysis, UI/UX, and research. I value teamwork, problem-solving, and learning together. Let's build something impactful!
summary:
Space Care can analyze data, predict harmfuls, and give a report to the astronaut, with helping LLMs.
SPACE CARE FAMILY CONNECT : https://space-care-family-app.vercel.app/
A key feature of  SPACE CARE that keeps astronauts' families connected and reassured during space missions through simple messaging, voice and video calls, astronaut wellness updates, and mission notifications.
Designed with an easy, accessible interface for all ages, especially elderly family members.
Bringing families closer, even beyond Earth.
details:
- It can analyze data, predict harmfuls, and give a report to the astronaut. Now it's a prototype, not a ready product or perfect MVP.

- We used virtual data to use it and produced astronauts profiles.

- We will develop it after the challenges, so we hope you can use it.

- We used Python with some libraries (like Pandas) and frameworks for backend, Ollama for local model, and TypeScript & React & HTML/CSS for frontend, and Google AI Studio for writing code.

- It's creative due to our vision and AI usage, and it can analyze many things of the astronaut due to factors like gravity and isolation.
